description_en: Provides a one-stop AI-powered image processing service for e-commerce sellers. Orchestrates seven atomic capabilities — element detection, intelligent matting, intelligent removal, Image Translation Pro, image expansion, intelligent cropping, and HD upscaling — into an image processing workflow. Users upload an image once, select the desired capabilities, and complete multiple image optimizations sequentially in a single call to produce product images that meet listing platform requirements. (Asynchronous)
description_zh: 面向电商卖家的一站式 AI 图片智能处理服务。将元素识别、智能抠图、智能消除、图片翻译 Pro、图像扩展、智能裁剪、高清放大七项原子能力编排为图片处理工作流，用户只需一次上传图片、勾选所需能力，即可按顺序一次性完成多项图片优化，输出符合铺货平台要求的商品图。（异步）
name: VisionFlow

parameters.help_en: The URL of the image to process. Required. Resolution must be greater than 256×256, long side no greater than 1920 pixels, short side no greater than 1080 pixels. File size must not exceed 5 MB. Supported formats: png, jpeg, jpg, bmp, webp
parameters.help_zh: 待处理图片URL，必填。分辨率应大于256×256，长边不大于1920像素，短边不大于1080像素；大小不超过5MB；支持png、jpeg、jpg、bmp、webp
parameters.name: image_url

parameters.help_en: The AI capabilities to apply (1=Intelligent Element Detection, 2=Intelligent Matting, 3=Intelligent Removal, 4=Image Translation Pro, 5=Intelligent Cropping, 6=HD Upscaling). Multiple selections allowed
parameters.help_zh: 选择需要处理的AI能力（1=智能元素识别，2=智能抠图，3=智能消除，4=图片翻译Pro，5=智能裁剪，6=高清放大），可多选
parameters.name: ability

parameters.help_en: The elements to detect on the image subject (1=Watermark, 2=Logo, 3=Text, 4=Text-bearing color block). Multiple selections allowed. When the Intelligent Element Detection capability is selected, at least one of ObjectDetectElements or NonobjectDetectElements is required
parameters.help_zh: 检测图片主体上的元素（1=水印；2=Logo；3=文字；4=含字色块），可多选。选择智能元素识别能力时，与NonobjectDetectElements至少有一项必填
parameters.name: object_detect_elements

parameters.help_en: The elements to detect on the non-subject area of the image (1=Watermark, 2=Logo, 3=Text, 4=Text-bearing color block). Multiple selections allowed. When the Intelligent Element Detection capability is selected, at least one of NonobjectDetectElements or ObjectDetectElements is required
parameters.help_zh: 检测非图片主体上的元素（1=水印；2=Logo；3=文字；4=含字色块），可多选。选择智能元素识别能力时，与ObjectDetectElements至少有一项必填
parameters.name: nonobject_detect_elements

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether images containing the specified elements proceed to subsequent processing. A value of true indicates that images with the specified elements proceed to subsequent processing. A value of false indicates that images without the specified elements proceed. Required when the Intelligent Element Detection capability is selected
parameters.help_zh: 选择带有此元素的图片进入后续处理还是不带。true表示带有元素的图片进入后续处理，false表示不带。选择智能元素识别能力时必填
parameters.name: is_filter

parameters.help_en: The background type of the output image. Valid values: WHITE_BACKGROUND (white background) and TRANSPARENT (transparent background). Required when the Intelligent Matting capability is selected
parameters.help_zh: 指定返回的图像背景形式。取值：WHITE_BACKGROUND（白底图）、TRANSPARENT（透明图）。选择智能抠图能力时必填
parameters.name: back_ground_type

parameters.help_en: The elements to remove from the image subject (1=Transparent text block, 2=Specific name, 3=Text, 4=Ad patch). Multiple selections allowed. When the Intelligent Removal capability is selected, at least one of ObjectRemoveElements or NonobjectRemoveElements is required
parameters.help_zh: 去除图片主体上的元素（1=透明字块；2=特定名称；3=文字；4=牛皮癣），可多选。选择智能消除能力时，与NonobjectRemoveElements至少有一项必填
parameters.name: object_remove_elements

parameters.help_en: The elements to remove from the non-subject area of the image (1=Transparent text block, 2=Specific name, 3=Text, 4=Ad patch). Multiple selections allowed. When the Intelligent Removal capability is selected, at least one of NonobjectRemoveElements or ObjectRemoveElements is required
parameters.help_zh: 去除图片非主体上的元素（1=透明字块；2=特定名称；3=文字；4=牛皮癣），可多选。选择智能消除能力时，与ObjectRemoveElements至少有一项必填
parameters.name: nonobject_remove_elements

parameters.help_en: The specific removal area in RLE format. Optional. If provided, this takes priority and the ObjectRemoveElements and NonobjectRemoveElements parameters are ignored
parameters.help_zh: 具体的消除区域，RLE格式，选填。若传入将优先使用，忽略ObjectRemoveElements和NonobjectRemoveElements参数
parameters.name: mask

parameters.help_en: The source language code. Optional. Refer to the supported language pairs list for available language directions
parameters.help_zh: 源语言代码，选填。支持的语向见翻译支持语向列表
parameters.name: source_language

parameters.help_en: The target language code. Optional. Refer to the supported language pairs list for available language directions
parameters.help_zh: 目标语言代码，选填。支持的语向见翻译支持语向列表
parameters.name: target_language

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to translate text on the image subject. Optional. Default value: false. Helps protect embedded information such as product names from being translated
parameters.help_zh: 是否翻译图片主体上文字，选填，默认false。可帮助保护商品名称等嵌入信息避免被翻译
parameters.name: including_product_area

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to translate brand names in the image. Optional. Default value: false. Helps protect brand name information from being translated
parameters.help_zh: 是否翻译图片上的品牌名，选填，默认false。可帮助保护品牌名信息避免被翻译
parameters.name: translating_brand_in_the_product

parameters.help_en: The glossary ID. Optional. Create the glossary separately in the console and provide its ID. If empty, translation results are not modified
parameters.help_zh: 干预词表ID，选填。需在前台单独创建并提供其ID。如果为空则翻译结果不会被修改
parameters.name: glossary

parameters.help_en: The desired width of the cropped image, in pixels. Valid values: 100 to 5000. Required when the Intelligent Cropping capability is selected
parameters.help_zh: 期望裁剪成的图片宽度，单位像素，取值100-5000。选择智能裁剪能力时必填
parameters.name: target_width

parameters.help_en: The desired height of the cropped image, in pixels. Valid values: 100 to 5000. Required when the Intelligent Cropping capability is selected
parameters.help_zh: 期望裁剪成的图片高度，单位像素，取值100-5000。选择智能裁剪能力时必填
parameters.name: target_height

parameters.help_en: The image upscaling factor. Optional. Default value: 2. Valid values: 2 to 4. Required when the HD Upscaling capability is selected
parameters.help_zh: 图像放大倍数，选填，默认2倍，取值范围2-4。选择高清放大能力时必填
parameters.name: upscale_factor

Code.description_en: The status code. The value "success" is returned for a successful call
Code.description_zh: 状态码，正常调用时返回"success"

Data.description_en: The asynchronous task submit status data, which contains the asynchronous task ID
Data.description_zh: 异步任务提交结果数据，包含异步任务ID

TaskId.description_en: The asynchronous task ID, used to query processing results later through QueryAsyncTaskResult
TaskId.description_zh: 异步任务ID，用于后续通过QueryAsyncTaskResult查询处理结果
TaskId.title_en: 异步任务ID，用于后续查询结果
TaskId.title_zh: 异步任务ID，用于后续查询结果

Message.description_en: The error message. The value "Success" is returned for a successful call
Message.description_zh: 报错信息。正常调用时返回"Success"

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, used to uniquely identify a single API call
RequestId.description_zh: 请求ID，用来识别唯一一次请求调用

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the call is successful. A value of true indicates success. A value of false indicates failure
Success.description_zh: 是否调用成功。true代表成功，false代表失败
